title: [IFAC] Immersive Farm and Cook
description: A modpack about farming and cooking.
body:
## Description
A modpack about farming and cooking. You can be a farmer and a cook, experience the joy of cooking and farming.

> 一个关于下厨与耕种的养老整合包，体验下厨的耕种的乐趣。

It contains the _Farmer's Delight_ mod and some of its accessory packages.
> 这个整合包包含了“农夫乐事”及其部分附属包。

The crops include but are not limited to: cabbage, onion, tomato, and rice.
> 其中的农作物包括但不限于：卷心菜、洋葱、番茄、稻米

The food includes but is not limited to: fried eggs, beef patties, salads, dumplings, and popsicles.
> 其中的食物包括但不限于：煎鸡蛋、牛肉饼、沙拉、饺子、冰棍

There are also hot pot mechanisms and beverages, suitable for everyone who loves farming or cooking
> 还有火锅机制和饮料，适合每一个爱好耕种或下厨的人
